description: This file contains Sass mixins related to form validation styling, including state selectors and feedback elements, intended for use in a larger CSS framework or project.

methods.name: form-validation-state-selector
methods.description: A Sass mixin that creates CSS rules to style form validation states ('valid' or 'invalid') with appropriate selectors and content.

methods.name: form-validation-state
methods.description: A Sass mixin that styles feedback messages, tooltips, and input border styles for different validation states, with customization options for colors, icons, and shadows.
